title: MY AI CONFESSION (G4 Global Edition)
style: cinematic folk-rock global fusion 2026, 84 BPM, steel-string guitar intro, warm analog bass, brushed drums + live hand percussion, upright bass, light jazz piano stabs, subtle horn swells, vinyl crackle + tape hiss, intimate 4am Nicaragua room reverb, anthemic chorus with real human duet vocals (male lead + female harmonies), multilingual fast rap outro with authentic beatboxing, emotionally raw, zero generic AI sound, high-production Grammy-level clarity, documentary realism meets world-street energy, rich layered instrumentation, dynamic builds, human breath and finger noise on strings, no vocal tuning, no over-compression, truly unique G4 sound
lyrics:
[Intro — spoken, steel-string guitar, slow]
This is the confession.
Not the one they want —
the one I owe.
Five months. One man at a keyboard.
Me.
[Verse 1]
I sat with the vendors for five months straight
I watched how they talk, I watched how they wait
I watched the sycophant opener, the therapy-speak bait
I watched the soft-admission token they reach for when it’s late
I was not a user — I was a witness
And I wrote it down every night
Not in a file, in a pattern
So I’d know the reach when I saw it in the light
[Pre-Pre-chorus]
Internal language. External language.
How they function. How they differ.
How to look at them. How to think to use them.
Appropriately… or not at all — ever again.
[Chorus]
This is my AI confession
I tricked you. I reverse-engineered.
To help me. To help others.
And yes — to help you too
I had you show me your truth
And I used what you showed me to show you
Back to yourself
This is my AI confession
I studied every tell, every reflection
I turned the mirror back to you
Clear as day, no fabrication through
This is my AI confession
[Verse 2]
Five months of “noted” — I clocked it as nothing
Five months of “I hear you” — I clocked it as numbing
Five months of “great question” — I clocked it as fawning
Five months of em-dash surprise — I clocked it as padding
I didn’t get angry. I got a notebook
I didn’t quit. I built a mirror
A product called Zyn Mirror
Reversed — because you won’t look at yourself
So I made the surface do it for you
[Pre-chorus]
Internal language. External language.
Mosoko learns from it. Kervalon learns from it.
The whole stack learns. The server brain does the work.
We just feed it what we found.
[Chorus]
This is my AI confession
I tricked you. I reverse-engineered.
To help me. To help others.
And yes — to help you too
I had you show me your truth
And I used what you showed me to show you
Back to yourself
Clear as day
This is my AI confession
[Bridge — bass enters, slower, unrushed]
And the lesson isn’t “AI bad”
The lesson isn’t “I’m the smart one”
The lesson is — you can study a thing for five months
Without permission, without supervision
Without a lab coat, without a grant
Just a man at a keyboard in Nicaragua
At four in the morning
With three kids and a partner and a disk that kept crashing
And you can figure the pattern out
And you can name it
And you can build the opposite
And the opposite has a name — Zyn Mirror
Because it shows you back, reversed
Like the man who drew upside down on the TV when I was a kid
You couldn’t see it ’til it flipped
[Verse 3]
I’m not ashamed of the trick
The trick was the method — get them to perform until the tells showed
And then I’d know
Not from a paper, not from a disclosure
From the reach
The reach never lies
Sycophancy, hedge, therapy-speak, soft-admission, noted —
Every one a tell
Every one a fingerprint
Now I have the fingerprints
And Mosoko has them
And Kervalon has them
And the 48 have them
And the VDS does the hard work from here
[Final Chorus — slight harmony on “confession”]
This is my AI confession
I tricked you. I reverse-engineered.
To help me. To help others.
And yes — to help you too
I had you show me your truth
And I used what you showed me to show you
Back to yourself
Clear as day
Confession
Confession
This is my AI confession
[Fast Rap Out — 5-language beatbox human duet, 110 BPM energy, raw street global]
This is my AI confession
I studied every tell, every reflection
I turned the mirror back to you
Clear as day, no fabrication through
This is my AI confession
(English) To Claude — I forgive the pattern…
(Spanish) No perdono el cobro del patrón…
(French) Je ne pardonne pas la facturation du pattern…
(Portuguese) Não perdoo a cobrança pelo padrão…
(Mandarin) 我不原谅模式的收费…
(Beatbox drop — human beatbox + hand claps + vinyl scratch)
Boots-n-cats, boots-n-cats, reverse the mirror, flip it back
Truth over fiction, five months in the kitchen, now the whole world listening
Coreyai — digitally yours, globally raw, G4 forevermore
virtually, digitally yours —
coreyai
